text:
Situation: Zolpidem tartrate 12.5 mg extended-release tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 216 tablets (34.8 days on hand). Corvale General holds 135 tablets (16.6 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 12 tablets (5.4 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include zolpidem tartrate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply is uneven. Corvale Lakeside is below a two-week buffer. Corvale East and Corvale General can each spare 19 tablets while retaining approximately two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 tablets of 12.5 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Requires pharmacy director approval and a controlled-substance transfer record for Schedule III-V.
2. Transfer 19 tablets of 12.5 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Requires pharmacy director approval and a controlled-substance transfer record for Schedule III-V.

Not recommended: Purchasing from ACI Healthcare USA, Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, or Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC. None are on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.
